source: GoogleTrendArchive: Google Trends 'Trending Now' national feeds for 125 countries, collected every 10 minutes, Nov. 27, 2024 to May 17, 2026. Topics merged by the world-attention pipeline.
note: The 60 widest shocks (unscheduled global moments, each checked by hand), at event level: the main topic plus topics accepted as the same event, from 2 hours before the moment to 24 hours after. curve = countries trending every 10 minutes for 3 hours (0, 10, ... 180), timed from the third country's first trend; countries_24h = all countries in the window. map = [country, minutes after the first country]. type: death and outage from the pipeline's keyword rule and hand labels; politics or conflict and other from the sub-kind rule.
takeaway: Most shocks reach half their countries within an hour.
